experiment: 15N R1, R2 and {1H}-15N NOE at 800 MHz, model-free analysis
buffer: 30 mM sodium phosphate, 30 mM NaCl, 20 mM DTT, 5% 2H2O
ligand_or_partner: none (apo, FMN removed by trichloroacetic acid precipitation and refolding)
other_conditions: tumbling: tau_m = 7.36±0.02 ns, D∥/D⊥ = 1.15±0.02 (axially symmetric); 107 of 149 residues analysed; model-free models M1-M5; related structures: 2M6S (holo-YqcA), 2M6R (this apo structure)
timescale: Rex, us-ms conformational exchange (model M3 residues; numeric values only in figures)
alt_state_structure: 2M6S: holo-YqcA, FMN-bound state with ordered P-loop and 50s loop and helix alpha1 extended (Results, Figure 1C-E)
author_claim: Apo-YqcA core is rigid (M1 residues mean S2 = 0.89±0.05) but 21 residues, many around the FMN pocket, need a us-ms Rex term; 23 amides are missing.
anchor: Twenty-one residues (Gly9, Val18, Glu20, Glu21, Glu23, Ala24, Thr34, Phe36, Asp38, Glu40, Val52, Thr56, Phe72, Gly74, Ala91, Gly93, Ser95, Gln106, Phe107, Asp126 and Glu134) were assigned to model M3, with an average S 2 = 0.90±0.04 and conformational exchanges ( R ex ) on the µs-ms timescales.
locator: Results, Backbone dynamics of YqcA; conditions: Methods, Sample preparation and Relaxation measurements
caveat_note: Residue list is the model-M3 set; G62 and F100 (M4), M122 and N130 (M2) and G80, F81, S128, E129, S149 (M5) are also named in the text. BMRB 25013 is the apo relaxation set. Note: the apo-form P-loop (phosphate-binding loop) was studied in 30 mM sodium phosphate; the authors do not discuss possible phosphate occupancy of the loop.

experiment: 15N R1, R2 and {1H}-15N NOE at 800 MHz, model-free analysis
other_conditions: tumbling: tau_m = 7.89±0.02 ns, D∥/D⊥ = 1.19±0.02 (axially symmetric); 136 of 149 residues analysed; related structures: 2M6R (apo-YqcA), 2M6S (this holo structure)
timescale: Rex, us-ms conformational exchange (model M3 residues; numeric values only in figures)
alt_state_structure: 2M6R: apo-YqcA, FMN-binding loops flexible with many missing amides (Results, Figure 1A,B,E)
author_claim: FMN binding suppresses most exchange around the pocket; Thr59, Gly60 and Gly62 in the 50s loop still show us-ms exchange.
anchor: Six residues (Met11, Asn14, Thr27, Ala33, Thr59 and Gly60) were assigned to model M3, with an average S 2 = 0.90±0.06 and conformational exchanges ( R ex ) on the µs-ms timescales.
locator: Results, Backbone dynamics of YqcA; conditions: Methods
caveat_note: Holo sample; the deposit card (BMRB 25013) is the apo sample. G62 is from model M4 and is named in the text as exchanging.

experiment: 2D 15N-edited HSQC of apo-YqcA, FMN titration at 800 MHz
buffer: 30 mM sodium phosphate, 30 mM NaCl, 20 mM DTT, 5% 2H2O
other_conditions: 23 backbone amides missing in the apo HSQC, 10 of them in the P-loop (G9-N14) and 50s loop (S57-I68); regime (authors): intermediate conformational exchange on the NMR timescale; related structures: 2M6S
alt_state_structure: 2M6S: holo-YqcA, loops well defined after FMN binding (Results, Figure 1C-E)
author_claim: Missing apo amides cluster at the FMN-binding loops, which are well defined after FMN binding.
anchor: Notably, among the 23 missing residues in the 15 N-edited HSQC spectrum of the apo-form, 10 are located in these two loops, suggesting intermediate conformational exchanges on the NMR timescale.
locator: Results, NMR characterizations of YqcA (Figure 1); conditions: Methods
caveat_note: Residue ranges are the loop boundaries given in the text, not a list of the missing amides. The spectrometer for the apo HSQC is not stated separately (600 or 800 MHz). Directly purified YqcA gave two sets of peaks in slow exchange (holo and apo forms), which is a mixture, not an intrinsic conformer pair. Note: the apo-form P-loop (phosphate-binding loop) was studied in 30 mM sodium phosphate; the authors do not discuss possible phosphate occupancy of the loop.

experiment: 2D HSQC of apo-FldA with spectral density mapping from 15N R1, R2, NOE at 800 MHz
buffer: 30 mM sodium phosphate, 30 mM NaCl, 20 mM DTT, 5% 2H2O
other_conditions: regime (authors): extensive conformational exchange on the intermediate timescales; related structures: 1AHN (crystal holo-FldA)
alt_state_structure: 2MOK: holo-FldA solution structure, FMN-bound state (Results, Figure 2A-C)
author_claim: About 30% of apo-FldA backbone signals are missing, clustered at the FMN pocket, indicating intermediate-timescale exchange.
anchor: Notably, the 2D HSQC spectrum of apo-FldA showed significant peak broadening and about 30% of the backbone signals were missing, suggesting extensive conformational exchanges on the intermediate timescales.
locator: Results, NMR characterizations of E. coli FldA (Figure 2D-E)
caveat_note: Different E. coli protein (FldA), a paralog of YqcA; do not attach to the YqcA entry. Note: the apo-form P-loop (phosphate-binding loop) was studied in 30 mM sodium phosphate; the authors do not discuss possible phosphate occupancy of the loop.
